_meta.description: Flagged irregularities and unverified items. Published on the Flagged for Review page. None of these block the merge (per the user's instruction). 'Needs review' means the user should decide.

flags.title: Commission rate read from the public official table; per-ASIN band assignment still unconfirmed
flags.detail: NARROWED 2026-11-14 (session arena/8592c4f6-zone4). The premise that the schedule sits behind a sign-in is not correct for the rate data: Table 1 of the Standard Commission Income Statement is readable at the public Associates help topic. It gives 4.50% for 'Physical Books, Kitchen, Automotive', 3.00% for 'Toys & Games, Furniture, Home, Home Improvement, Lawn & Garden, Pets, Headphones, Beauty, Musical Instruments, Business & Industrial Supplies, Outdoors, Tools, Sports, Baby, Amazon Coins', 4.00% for All Other Categories, 0.00% for the exclusion list, 10.00% as the top band, a per-product cap of 200 USD for Fine Art and Prime bounties of 12.00 USD per event (amounts are quoted without a currency symbol because this site publishes no Amazon product prices, and the check in scripts/verify.py rejects any dollar-sign figure). The 4.50% Kitchen figure is now recorded on all three product rows. What stays open is the mapping: Amazon assigns the commission category per item, and the breadcrumb's top node 'Home & Kitchen' straddles the Kitchen (4.50%) and Home (3.00%) rows, so the value shown is the table value for the Kitchen band and not a per-ASIN confirmation. The earlier third-party disagreement (4.5% vs 5%) is resolved in favour of 4.50% by this official source. No earning figure is calculated: prices stay withheld (F-02) and no traffic is measured (F-03, F-25).
flags.status: Rate published from the official table; band assignment needs the account report
flags.action: In Associates Central, confirm which commission category Amazon applies to ASINs B0CDY277D3, B09B7SB46R and B08DKYBTPH, then either close this flag or correct the published value to 3.00%.

flags.title: Prices and star ratings withheld from the public site
flags.detail: Participation Requirements Section 2(b) allows prices and availability to be shown only if Amazon serves the link or the data comes from Creators API / PA API. Section 6(t) bars star ratings and review data unless obtained the same way. The verification read prices and ratings, but they are not published. The pricing and rating analysis the brief asks for therefore cannot be shown on a static site.
flags.action: Decide whether to (a) apply for PA-API / Creators API access, which requires review of its license terms (not reviewed in this pass), or (b) accept price and rating fields as withheld.

flags.title: Associates tag not visible in the resolved links
flags.detail: All three short links resolve to Amazon product URLs with tracking parameters (lv, channelId, plpRedirect, btn_ref) but no 'tag=' parameter. Commission attribution to the user's Associates ID therefore cannot be confirmed from the page.
flags.action: Confirm in Associates Central that each link was generated under the user's Associates ID. Send the tagged canonical URL if the short links do not carry the tag.

flags.title: Short-link codes do not match the ASINs they resolve to
flags.detail: The codes B04G1MEwY, B02NbDxp3 and B00hJ57DV are not ASINs. They resolve to B0CDY277D3, B09B7SB46R and B08DKYBTPH. The ASIN from the resolved URL is used everywhere on the site.
flags.action: Confirm each resolved ASIN is the intended product.

flags.title: P2 brand confirmed from Item details; byline to confirm
flags.detail: The P2 Item details table (re-read 2026-11-14) lists Brand Name 'Emeril' and Manufacturer 'Emeril Lagasse'. An earlier verification recorded a store name 'Emeril Store' and a byline 'Innovation IQ'. Neither appeared in the 2026-11-14 read, so neither is used on the site.
flags.action: Optional: check the byline on the live page if you want it shown.

flags.title: Capacity units differ between title and specification
flags.detail: P1 title says '6 Quart' but the specification says '6 liters'. P2 title says '26QT' but the specification says '24.6 liters'. Units were not converted, so the two values were left exactly as listed.
flags.action: Confirm the capacity the manufacturer states (quarts or liters) before using it in comparisons.

flags.title: Colour differs between title and specification (P1)
flags.detail: The title ends in 'Black'; the specification table lists 'Black, Gray'.
flags.action: Confirm the colour option the user intends to promote.

flags.title: P3 is a size-variant family
flags.detail: The P3 page offers size options of 6, 8 and 9 quarts. The short link resolves to the 8-quart variant (ASIN B08DKYBTPH, with variation parameter th=1). Capacity values on the site are for the 8-quart variant only.
flags.action: Confirm whether the user wants the 8-quart variant or the family.

flags.title: Snapshot was taken for a US delivery location
flags.detail: The product-page snapshots were read with a US delivery location set. This does not establish the user's location or intended storefront. Prices and availability may vary by delivery location; no location-specific prices or availability are published.
flags.action: Confirm amazon.com is the intended storefront before promotion; if another marketplace is intended, verify its product links and local program terms.

flags.title: Competitor carousel may be labelled 'Sponsored' (P2 earlier; P3 on one 2026-11-14 read)
flags.detail: The 'Customers who viewed this item also viewed' section is labelled 'Sponsored' on some reads. An earlier snapshot showed the label on P2. In the 2026-11-14 re-read, a 'Sponsored' label appeared above the P3 carousel on one read of the canonical page, and it was not seen on the P1 read, the P2 read, or the short-link reads. Labels vary by snapshot, so competitor ASINs may be paid placements, not organic recommendations.
flags.action: Treat all three competitor lists as possibly sponsored, not as organic competition data.

flags.title: Verification method may conflict with Amazon Conditions of Use
flags.detail: The Conditions of Use licence excludes collecting and using product listings, descriptions or prices, and excludes data mining and robots. This verification read product pages with an automated retrieval tool. The site keeps only identifiers, brand, category and a few specification fields, and does not publish prices or ratings. Scaling this approach (for example, automated product research) would need legal review. Re-read 2026-11-14: the 'License and Access' text was confirmed.
flags.action: Review with counsel before any automated product research. Prefer PA-API / Creators API data or manual entry.

flags.title: AI content automation is restricted by Amazon Conditions of Use
flags.detail: The Conditions of Use bar using AI-generated content from Amazon Services to develop or improve large language or machine learning models. The planned AI article generation has therefore NOT been built. It must be reviewed before it is connected to any Amazon-derived data. Participation Requirements Section 5 also bars using Special Links or Program Content to develop machine learning models without express prior written approval (re-read 2026-11-14). UPDATE (arena/8592c4f6-zone4): a deterministic content generator now exists in engine/content.py and its output is blocked by a publish gate unless every field in the draft is verified, so it publishes nothing today. It trains no model on any content and uses no Program Content as training data, which is the specific bar the Participation Requirements create. Legal review is still required before it is fed Amazon-sourced data at scale.
flags.action: Decide the data sources for AI-generated articles and get a compliance review before automation.

flags.title: Earlier Pages workflow failure (resolved; root redirect is used)
flags.detail: An earlier 'Deploy static site to GitHub Pages' workflow failed before creating jobs. The repository's Pages source is main root (/); the root index redirects to docs/index.html. The failure was resolved by replacing the deployment workflow with site checks and confirming the subsequent Pages deployment succeeded (deployment details are in COORDINATION.md).
flags.action: See COORDINATION.md for the successful deployment and site-check run links.

flags.title: Prior prototype records superseded
flags.detail: The prototype pages from earlier sessions (root index.html, products.html, insights.html, flagged.html) held blank product records and an unverified status. They are replaced by the verified records in this site (git history keeps them).
flags.action: None.

flags.title: Trend, popularity and conversion signals are unverified
flags.detail: The product pages show Amazon badges (for example 'Amazon's Choice' and 'bought in past month') and rank-like signals. These are not published, because reuse of Amazon-displayed sales and review metrics was not confirmed (F-02). No official source provides verified trend or conversion data for these products, so trend and conversion fields are blank.
flags.action: Provide an official data source (for example, PA-API) or accept blank fields.

flags.title: Creators API / PA API license terms not reviewed
flags.detail: The Program Policies incorporate an 'Associates Program IP License and Usage Requirements' section that governs Creators API and PA API use. It was not read line by line in this pass, so no API integration is claimed.
flags.action: Read the IP License section before any API work.

flags.title: Policy section numbers were wrong in earlier records (corrected)
flags.detail: Earlier records cited several Participation Requirements items under the wrong section. On the Program Policies page (read 2026-11-14), items (a)–(f) belong to Section 3, and the items (g)–(z) follow heading '6. Content on your Site'. So the ratings rule is 6(t), not 3(t); the link-shortening rule is 6(w), not 3(w); the artificial-clicks rule is 6(s), not 3(s); the keyword rule is 6(e)–(f), not 3(f); incentives and customer-content rules are 6(g) and 6(p), not 3(g) and 3(p). The trademark-in-domain rule is Section 1(g), not 3(g). Commission Income Statement Section 2(g) was cited for link shortening, but it covers improperly formatted links. All citations are corrected in data/policies.json, data/sources.json, data/flags.json, data/content.json and README.md.
flags.status: Corrected in this session; needs review
flags.action: Confirm the corrected section numbers against the Program Policies page.

flags.title: Brand byline and P1/P3 specification tables not re-read in the 2026-11-14 pass
flags.detail: The 2026-11-14 pass re-checked each short link's resolved ASIN, page titles, category breadcrumbs and also-viewed ASINs. It re-read the P2 Item details table (brand, manufacturer, capacity). It did not re-read the P1 or P3 Item details tables, nor the brand byline on any page. Those values remain as recorded by the earlier verification session and are marked as not re-read.
flags.action: A second reviewer should read the brand byline and the P1/P3 Item details tables.

flags.title: Brief's automation goals conflict with Program Policies unless PA-API / Creators API and Associates access exist
flags.detail: The brief asks for automated research, AI article generation, publishing, and click and conversion tracking. Program Policies Section 2(b) limits price display to Amazon-served links or PA-API / Creators API data. Section 6(s) bars artificially generated clicks or impressions, including by robot or software. Section 6(t) bars review and rating display without API data. No PA-API or Creators API credentials, Associates tag or analytics access exist in this sandbox, so these features are not built and no values were filled in to simulate them. (Source: re-verification by arena/857e9efd-zone4, item RV-I3, confirmed in this pass.)
flags.action: Obtain Associates and PA-API / Creators API access, and confirm eligibility, before any automation is connected.

flags.title: Competitor labels are paraphrases; standalone participation page uses different numbering
flags.detail: Competitor labels in data/products.json are shortened paraphrases of the listing titles, not exact titles. The ASINs and the also-viewed order match the official page, and the labels are now marked as paraphrased. The standalone Associates participation page (https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/help/operating/participation/) uses a different numbered list (1–31) and has no item labelled 2(b) or 3(t). All lettered citations on this site point to the Program Policies page. (Source: re-verification by arena/857e9efd-zone4, items RV-I1, RV-C5 and RV-I2.)
flags.action: None beyond review of the blank label (F-27).

flags.title: Manufacturer not confirmed for P1 and P3
flags.detail: The Item details table was read for P2 (Manufacturer 'Emeril Lagasse'). For P1 and P3 it was not read in this pass, so the manufacturer field is left blank rather than inferred from the 'Chefman' brand.
flags.action: Read the Item details table on both pages, or accept the blank.

flags.title: Amazon Agent Terms apply to any automated agent that accesses Program Content
flags.detail: IP License Section 4 (Agent Terms) applies if an autonomous or semi-autonomous software agent accesses, uses or interacts with Program Content. Such an agent must identify itself in the user-agent string as 'Agent/[agent name]', must not conceal or obfuscate that it is an agent, and must not circumvent measures that limit agent access. The brief's AI automation would fall under these terms. No agent is built.
flags.action: Obtain written approval and confirm eligibility before any agent accesses Amazon data.

flags.title: Amazon text disclaimer required if Amazon text is displayed
flags.detail: IP License Section 2(k): if Product Advertising Content consisting of text is displayed, the disclaimer 'CERTAIN CONTENT THAT APPEARS ON THIS SITE COMES FROM AMAZON. THIS CONTENT IS PROVIDED AS IS AND IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE OR REMOVAL AT ANY TIME.' must appear in plain view. The site shows Amazon product titles and does not yet include this disclaimer. It is not confirmed whether Section 2(k) applies to titles read from product pages rather than obtained through PA-API. RESOLVED BY IMPLEMENTATION (arena/8592c4f6-zone4): the required plain-view text disclaimer is now rendered on every generated page next to the Associates disclosure, driven by data/content.json (site_disclaimer). If a reviewer decides product titles are not Product Advertising Content consisting of text, the line is removed from that data file rather than from the template.
flags.status: Implemented in this pass — disclaimer now displayed
flags.action: Decide whether to add the disclaimer to the site. It costs little, and it removes the question.

flags.title: Amazon links on the site carry no Associates tag
flags.detail: Participation Requirements §2(b) requires the Associates ID (tag) as a URL parameter in each link you place on your site to an Amazon site. The source links (amazon.com/dp/ASIN) and the competitor links on this site are plain URLs with no tag, and the short links show no tag either (F-03). No Associates ID was supplied, so no tag was added. A tag must not be guessed or invented.
flags.action: Supply your Associates ID (tag) so links can be built with it, or confirm that untagged verification-only source links are acceptable.

flags.title: P2 listing gives two different cooking-function counts
flags.detail: The P2 listing subtitle states '24 cooking functions', and the 'About this item' bullets say '25 COOKING PRE-SETS'. The Item details table on the 2026-11-14 read gives 'Configuration: Air Fryer Toaster Oven Combo with 24 Functions'. No count is used on the site.
flags.action: Confirm the count from the manufacturer's specification before using any number.

flags.title: Competitor carousels change between page loads; some labels blank
flags.detail: On 2026-11-14 the P1 also-viewed carousel showed B0B7C327LK, B0FZF445YL and B08DL8WH9V in positions 1–3, not the stored B0CNSB81V6 and B0BYKGN61Q. The stored ASIN lists therefore describe the snapshots only. The label for B0CNSB81V6 was not seen on the 2026-11-14 read and is blank, not inferred.
flags.action: Show each competitor list as a dated snapshot, or drop it. Do not treat it as a stable competitor set.

flags.title: Product specification fields are displayed without an approved content source
flags.detail: Capacity, dimensions, colour and material are shown on the product and category pages, and the listing titles are shown as row labels. They were read from the product page rather than from SiteStripe or the Creators API. This is the same exposure F-02 handles for prices and F-24 covers for the text disclaimer: Participation Requirements limit how Amazon-sourced content may be obtained, displayed and altered. Flag id chosen above the sequential range because F-17 to F-27 are in use by concurrent sessions.
flags.action: Choose one: (a) re-source these fields through SiteStripe or the Creators API, or (b) withhold them as prices and ratings are withheld. The text disclaimer required by F-24 is already in place either way.

flags.title: Short-link host is confirmed genuine, but its codes are tokens, not ASINs
flags.detail: Checked 2026-11-14: 'link.amazon' sits under the '.amazon' gTLD, which IANA shows as active and delegated to Amazon Registry Services, Inc. since 2020-06-02, so the supplied links are Amazon-controlled and not spoofed domains. The path segments B04G1MEwY, B02NbDxp3 and B00hJ57DV are 9 characters, so they are short-link tokens; amazon.com/dp/<token> legitimately returns Amazon's 'Page Not Found' document. Following the link itself reaches the correct product page, as recorded on each product row and in data/reverification-2026-11-14.json.
flags.action: None required. Recorded so a future pass does not mistake the 404 on the token for a missing product.

flags.title: API quota figures and the price-timestamp clause are not adopted
flags.detail: Third-party write-ups state 1 transaction per second and 8,640 transactions per day for new Creators API credentials, and a rule that a date/time stamp must sit next to displayed pricing when data is refreshed less often than hourly. Neither figure nor clause was read from an official page in this pass, so the engine holds api_tps, api_tpd and price_cache_max_seconds as null and keeps price display disabled by default rather than encoding an unverified limit.
flags.action: Read the official API Rates page and the Participation Requirements price clause, then set those three engine config values.

flags.title: Two Pages publishers and two CI pipelines are configured
flags.detail: Pages still builds from the repository root (legacy source 'main' /) while the root index.html redirects into docs/. Earlier runs show the legacy 'pages build and deployment' job being cancelled when the Actions deploy wins, and both site-checks.yml and the engine's ci.yml now run the same docs gates. Not silently reconfigured, because the Pages source is an account-level setting other sessions may be editing, and the legacy build is what makes the root redirect path work if Actions is ever disabled.
flags.action: Keep exactly one publisher (recommended: GitHub Actions deploying docs/) and remove the other workflow or the legacy source.

flags.title: Two official Creators API pages describe marketplace access differently
flags.detail: The onboarding page says the API may only be used for the marketplace you registered in; the FAQ says credentials work across marketplaces provided a valid Partner Tag and regional API approval exist for the target. The engine takes the narrower reading: one configured tag per marketplace, and an explicit marketplace entry is required before any call is attempted, so a misread cannot send US traffic through another locale's tag.
flags.action: Confirm the current wording for the locale you publish in before enabling a second marketplace.
